title: Distributed Event-Driven Pipeline Architecture Defense
description: Defend the core architecture, concurrency trade-offs, state store consistency, and failure modes of an event-driven data pipeline under production burst traffic.

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: In your project artifact {artifact_id} under {section}, you outlined {topic}. Walk through how requests flow from the entry point to the final state store.
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: Candidate must articulate clear boundary between ingestion, message broker, and consumer workers.

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: Referring back to your note on {topic} in {artifact_id}: what happens when 50,000 requests burst into the system in under 2 seconds? How does your backpressure mechanism behave?
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: Distinguishes between producer throttling (HTTP 429 / TCP window) and consumer worker autoscaling.

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: In your design for {topic}, why did you select {choice_a} rather than {choice_b}? What concrete latency or operational trade-off led to that choice?
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: Must articulate concrete drawbacks of chosen approach rather than presenting it as flawless.

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: You noted a production incident regarding {topic}. When downstream database writes fail repeatedly due to a network partition, how are poison pills quarantined without message loss?
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: Mentions dead-letter queue (DLQ) isolation, exponential retry backoff, and idempotent deduplication window.

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: What exact latency, throughput, or user count metrics were measured in your deployment?
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: If the project was a prototype/student project without live telemetry, candidate must state metrics are unmeasured/unknown rather than inventing numbers.

project.trade_off.unjustified.title: Distributed State Store Consistency Trade-offs
project.trade_off.unjustified.description: Deep-dive CAP theorem compromises, ACID vs BASE guarantees, and write-ahead log idempotency.

project.failure_mode.unhandled_poison_pi.title: Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) & Poison Pill Isolation
project.failure_mode.unhandled_poison_pi.description: Implement backoff retries, DLQ routing, and consumer fencing for non-recoverable payloads.

project.telemetry.missing_production_evi.title: Production Observability & SLA Measurement
project.telemetry.missing_production_evi.description: Structure synthetic benchmarking, p99 latency profiling, and Prometheus/Grafana counter monitoring.
